fact_check_rounds.label: Round 1: the 40 profiled plants (after the parallel list audit)

miss_rate.value: 38/126 = 30.2% (verified; both auditors); up to 46/134 = 34.3% with 8 unverified
miss_rate.note: The blind list audit ran in parallel with the finders, so every verified miss was added before profiling was chosen. Two-list (capture-recapture) estimate of the population the auditors' search methods reach: about 132 plants. Two closure passes then reconciled EPA's mining-machinery (333131) and construction-machinery (333120) registries and added 14 and 24 base plants; the best-scoring plant (Process Machinery, Shelbyville KY) came from closure, so the list has not converged. A bounded final pass (remaining 333120 rows and EPA 333922 conveying equipment) is running.

known_limits: Round-1 fact-check found 11.4% of checked claims needed correction (all applied; none changed a score). Most were company-level facts shown at one site; a pattern sweep and a confirming round are running.
Material scores 0 on most profiled plants: mining and construction sources rarely state a welded part's size or weight, and payloads, bucket capacities and machine classes do not count as part sizes.
EPA FRS was down (503) during parts of the finder stage; some registry quotes were checked only by the finders.
